newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to run into trouble from 109-05 on.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to run into trouble from 109-05 on.

text.p: June long gilt futures will try to trade higher on Friday but will be restrained by a loss of momentum, analysts said. They face resistance starting at 109-05.
"I don't see it going too far," said Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.
"Yesterday's high at 109-05 will act as resistance, and above that 109-09 and then 109-18,20," he said.
The 109-18 level was a high two days ago, and the 109-20 block is based on a top from late March.
June gilts on LIFFE were up 3/32 at 109-00 at 0708 GMT.
Gilts, bolstered on Friday by a firmer Bund market, had had a decent run going into Thursday's session, with several days of gains since touching a low at 108-05 on April 1.
"On the downside, I still quite like 108-29,30. It's congested around there," Cossor said, adding that 108-16,17 would also provide support. "We did some work around there last week."

Cossor said one reason the market would lack strong upward impetus was that on daily charts his 10-day momentum indicator had turned lower again. Also, with a some key U.S. inflation reports looming, bond markets would remain cautious for now.
Miranda Churchill, a London-based technical analyst, said the risk for gilts was the 108-25 level. That was a low on April 8. On Thursday gilts hit 108-28, also its low so far on Friday.

"If we take out 108-25 there's not a whole heap of support until we get down to test the lows that we saw at the beginning of last week," she said. "The only support I've got between 108-25 and the lows is 108-18."
But she added, "Providing we hold 108-25,26 the basic pattern is still positive in the short to medium term."
June short sterling was off 0.03 at 93.35. British monetary authorities met on Thursday though few expect a rate change yet.
